exposure: administration of two or more doses of oxytocics to augment labour before reaching facilities
time to reach a facility from home (>30 min)
time to attend to pregnant woman after reaching facility (>10 min)
institution of management time after reaching facility
cohort: The study included 400 stillbirth cases and 800 consecutive live births from the same population in two districts of Bihar, India.
finding: Modifiable health system-related risk factors, including delays in care at facilities, untreated hypertension, and complications during labour, were significantly associated with stillbirths, indicating that improved access, timeliness, and quality of obstetric services could prevent a substantial proportion.
